en_grezzo: "You don't recall becoming my assistant, you say? Well, don't worry about it. Anyways, I've analyzed the data left behind by the investigation unit and have made a discovery... In order to defeat the monster on the lowest level of Remido, you'll need to fling exceptionally pure ether at it once it becomes weak."

jp: ここから北東…エイレルの南東といったほうがわかりやすいか？そこの山岳地帯に強力なエーテル反応が確認されている。エーテルの根源を発見し、可能であれば回収してきてくれ。周囲に気化したエーテルが充満しているから抗体は多めに持っていくべきだぞ。
jp_grezzo: "ここから北東…エイレルの南東といったほうがわかりやすいか？そこの山岳地帯に強力なエーテル反応が確認されている。エーテルの根源を発見し、可能であれば回収してきてくれ。周囲に気化したエーテルが充満しているから抗体は多めに持っていくべきだぞ。"
en: If you travel northeast from here... Or maybe \"southeast of Eirel\" would be easier to understand? Anyways, we've discovered a strong ether reaction in the mountains there. Discover the cause of this and collect some of the ether in this capsule if you can. Due to the high concentration of ether in the air there you should probably take some potions of cure corruption with you.
en_grezzo: "If you travel northeast from here... Or maybe \"southeast of Eirel\" would be easier to understand? Anyways, we've discovered a strong ether reaction in the mountains there. Discover the cause of this and collect some of the ether in this capsule if you can. Due to the high concentration of ether in the air there you should probably take some potions of cure corruption with you."

jp: [回収用カプセル]を手に入れた！
jp_grezzo: "[回収用カプセル]を手に入れた！"
en: You obtain the [Recovery Capsule]!
en_grezzo: "You obtain the [Recovery Capsule]!"

jp: そろそろ戦闘データも集まった頃だと思ってな。…よし、ちゃんと記録されているな。データを吸いだしてっと…また頼むぞ。
jp_grezzo: "そろそろ戦闘データも集まった頃だと思ってな。…よし、ちゃんと記録されているな。データを吸いだしてっと…また頼むぞ。"
en: It's about time to look at the combat data you've collected so far... Alright, I've got it. Once you've gotten some more... I'll call you again.
en_grezzo: "It's about time to look at the combat data you've collected so far... Alright, I've got it. Once you've gotten some more... I'll call you again."

jp: そうそう、こいつは超兵士を作るために細胞を培養していたら偶然できた代物でな。興味もないし廃棄する予定だったんだが、もしかしたらお前が欲しがるかと思ってとっておいたのさ。遠慮せずに持って行け。
jp_grezzo: "そうそう、こいつは超兵士を作るために細胞を培養していたら偶然できた代物でな。興味もないし廃棄する予定だったんだが、もしかしたらお前が欲しがるかと思ってとっておいたのさ。遠慮せずに持って行け。"
en: Oh yes, this was a side-product of cultivating the cells we use to engineer super soldiers. There was no interest in it so I had planned to throw it out, but I thought you might want to have it instead. Go on and take it.
en_grezzo: "Oh yes, this was a side-product of cultivating the cells we use to engineer super soldiers. There was no interest in it so I had planned to throw it out, but I thought you might want to have it instead. Go on and take it."

jp: ご苦労。…うむ、派手にやったなお前。データが欠損してやがる。こうなったら、代わりにお前にデータ収集をしてきてもらうぞ。
jp_grezzo: "ご苦労。…うむ、派手にやったなお前。データが欠損してやがる。こうなったら、代わりにお前にデータ収集をしてきてもらうぞ。"
en: Sorry for the trouble... Well, looks like you busted it. The data is gone. In that case, you'll just have to gather the data instead.
en_grezzo: "Sorry for the trouble... Well, looks like you busted it. The data is gone. In that case, you'll just have to gather the data instead."

jp: 新しい[データレジスタ]を無理矢理持たされた…。
jp_grezzo: "新しい[データレジスタ]を無理矢理持たされた…。"
en: You obtain a new [Data Register]!
en_grezzo: "You obtain a new [Data Register]!"

jp: 確かにブツは受け取った。ほら、カードキーだ。調査部隊が使っているカードキーはまた別に指紋や声紋も照合するんだが、こいつは特別製だからその辺を省略できるぞ。冒険者はよく変異して体質が変わるからな、こっちのほうが都合がいいだろう。そうだ…おまけでこの像もやろう。
jp_grezzo: "確かにブツは受け取った。ほら、カードキーだ。調査部隊が使っているカードキーはまた別に指紋や声紋も照合するんだが、こいつは特別製だからその辺を省略できるぞ。冒険者はよく変異して体質が変わるからな、こっちのほうが都合がいいだろう。そうだ…おまけでこの像もやろう。"
en: Those are certainly the items I was looking for. Here, take your card key. The card key that the investigation unit carries uses both fingerprint matching and voice recognition for authentication, but this card is special. You won't have any need for all that. Since adventurers undergo so many changes on their travels, this will be far more convenient. Oh yes... and take this statue as well.
en_grezzo: "Those are certainly the items I was looking for. Here, take your card key. The card key that the investigation unit carries uses both fingerprint matching and voice recognition for authentication, but this card is special. You won't have any need for all that. Since adventurers undergo so many changes on their travels, this will be far more convenient. Oh yes... and take this statue as well."

jp: [カードキー]を手に入れた！
jp_grezzo: "[カードキー]を手に入れた！"
en: You obtain the [Card key]!
en_grezzo: "You obtain the [Card key]!"

jp: 将軍からさっき通信で聞いたよ。お前がレミードに潜りたがってる馬鹿だな。いいぞ、そういう馬鹿は嫌いじゃない。調査部隊に加わるかどうかに関係なく、個人的に協力してやろう。ただしちょっとしたおつかいをやってくれたら、だがな。その気になったらまた来い。
jp_grezzo: "将軍からさっき通信で聞いたよ。お前がレミードに潜りたがってる馬鹿だな。いいぞ、そういう馬鹿は嫌いじゃない。調査部隊に加わるかどうかに関係なく、個人的に協力してやろう。ただしちょっとしたおつかいをやってくれたら、だがな。その気になったらまた来い。"
en: So you must be the fool that wants to enter Remido. I've already heard all about it from the general. Good - I don't dislike fools at all. I'd like to cooperate with you personally, regardless of if you join the investigation unit or not. I won't be sending you on trifling tasks, however. Speak to me again if you're determined to go.
en_grezzo: "So you must be the fool that wants to enter Remido. I've already heard all about it from the general. Good - I don't dislike fools at all. I'd like to cooperate with you personally, regardless of if you join the investigation unit or not. I won't be sending you on trifling tasks, however. Speak to me again if you're determined to go."

jp: ちょっと待て、何だその小型ロボみたいなのは。ポーショマン？ほぅ、飲み物の栓を発射するのか…。
jp_grezzo: "ちょっと待て、何だその小型ロボみたいなのは。ポーショマン？ほぅ、飲み物の栓を発射するのか…。"
en: Wait, What's that robot-looking thing you are holding? A Potioman? and it can... shoot potion plugs??
en_grezzo: "Wait, What's that robot-looking thing you are holding? A Potioman? and it can... shoot potion plugs??"

jp: うーむ。ちゃちゃっと本体を強化してやろうと思ったが、これは一種の工芸品だな。繊細な職人技だらけで簡単には手を加えられん。外付けの強化パーツで機能を追加したほうがよさそうだ。
jp_grezzo: "うーむ。ちゃちゃっと本体を強化してやろうと思ったが、これは一種の工芸品だな。繊細な職人技だらけで簡単には手を加えられん。外付けの強化パーツで機能を追加したほうがよさそうだ。"
en: Huh, Full of delicate craftsmanship, it cannot be easily remodeled. It seems better to add functions with external reinforcement parts.
en_grezzo: "Huh, Full of delicate craftsmanship, it cannot be easily remodeled. It seems better to add functions with external reinforcement parts."

jp: ほれ、以前似たようなものを設計したことがあってな。即興でダウンサイジングして機能調整したが性能は保障する。
jp_grezzo: "ほれ、以前似たようなものを設計したことがあってな。即興でダウンサイジングして機能調整したが性能は保障する。"
en: Here's something handy for you Potioman. Don't worry about the size, it will do just fine.
en_grezzo: "Here's something handy for you Potioman. Don't worry about the size, it will do just fine."

jp: ここを外してこっちとくっつけて展開させると強化アームになり、こっちのジョイントをスライドしてこっちとくっつければバレルになる。さらにこれを分割してさっきの余剰パーツをここにはめ込んで…ん？分かったよ手順書もつけてやる。作った俺は苦にならないんだが…やはり皆が言うように複雑すぎたのか？一応、形態数を抑えて戦闘中でも組み替えられる程度に簡略化したつもりなんだぞ。まぁ、いい気晴らしになったよ。
jp_grezzo: "ここを外してこっちとくっつけて展開させると強化アームになり、こっちのジョイントをスライドしてこっちとくっつければバレルになる。さらにこれを分割してさっきの余剰パーツをここにはめ込んで…ん？分かったよ手順書もつけてやる。作った俺は苦にならないんだが…やはり皆が言うように複雑すぎたのか？一応、形態数を抑えて戦闘中でも組み替えられる程度に簡略化したつもりなんだぞ。まぁ、いい気晴らしになったよ。"
en: Here, an custom-made Exo-skeleton Module for your Potioman, and it's instructions. Have fun!
en_grezzo: "Here, an custom-made Exo-skeleton Module for your Potioman, and it's instructions. Have fun!"

jp: よう、。お前は面白そうだからな。何か用があるなら俺の貴重な時間を割いてやるぞ。
jp_grezzo: "よう、" + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "。お前は面白そうだからな。何か用があるなら俺の貴重な時間を割いてやるぞ。"
en: Yo, . You're quite the amusing fellow. If you've got anything important I'll spare some of my precious time for you.
en_grezzo: "Yo, " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + ". You're quite the amusing fellow. If you've got anything important I'll spare some of my precious time for you."

jp: 装備部位を増やしたい
jp_grezzo: "装備部位を増やしたい"
en: I want to increase my equipment slots.
en_grezzo: "I want to increase my equipment slots."

jp: レミードについて
jp_grezzo: "レミードについて"
en: I want to know more about Remido.
en_grezzo: "I want to know more about Remido."

jp: 機械要塞について
jp_grezzo: "機械要塞について"
en: Tell me about the Machine Fortress.
en_grezzo: "Tell me about the Machine Fortress."

jp: 異形の神殿について
jp_grezzo: "異形の神殿について"
en: Tell me about the Temple of Chaos.
en_grezzo: "Tell me about the Temple of Chaos."

jp: 黄泉の谷について
jp_grezzo: "黄泉の谷について"
en: Tell me about the Valley of Hades.
en_grezzo: "Tell me about the Valley of Hades."

jp: レミードは一般にはネフィアと混同されているが、オリジナル部分はネフィアではなく旧文明の施設だ。…オリジナルというのはだ、レミードは数百年単位で周囲の土地を取り込んでいてな。地上からスキャンしたところ、最下層以外はすべて周囲から吸収し再構築したものだと判明した。そして数千年後にはこの大陸全土が飲み込まれる計算だ。
jp_grezzo: "レミードは一般にはネフィアと混同されているが、オリジナル部分はネフィアではなく旧文明の施設だ。…オリジナルというのはだ、レミードは数百年単位で周囲の土地を取り込んでいてな。地上からスキャンしたところ、最下層以外はすべて周囲から吸収し再構築したものだと判明した。そして数千年後にはこの大陸全土が飲み込まれる計算だ。"
en: While Remido is typically mistaken as a ruin of Nefia, it was originally a facility from a different ancient civilization... I say originally, because it's been absorbing and reconstructing its surroundings for the past few hundred years. Through scanning from the surface, we were able to ascertain that everything but the bottom floor is a result of this process. And from our calculations it will swallow this continent and everything else in a few thousand years.
en_grezzo: "While Remido is typically mistaken as a ruin of Nefia, it was originally a facility from a different ancient civilization... I say originally, because it's been absorbing and reconstructing its surroundings for the past few hundred years. Through scanning from the surface, we were able to ascertain that everything but the bottom floor is a result of this process. And from our calculations it will swallow this continent and everything else in a few thousand years."

jp: 名前からも推測はつくだろうが、あれはレム・イド文明時代に建造された研究施設だ。レム・イドは生化学の発達した文明…おそらく研究していた何かが暴走した結果だろう。
jp_grezzo: "名前からも推測はつくだろうが、あれはレム・イド文明時代に建造された研究施設だ。レム・イドは生化学の発達した文明…おそらく研究していた何かが暴走した結果だろう。"
en: You've likely already guessed it from the name, but the facility was built during the civilization of Rehm-Ido, an era in which biochemistry flourished... It's quite possible that this is the result of some experiment gone haywire.
en_grezzo: "You've likely already guessed it from the name, but the facility was built during the civilization of Rehm-Ido, an era in which biochemistry flourished... It's quite possible that this is the result of some experiment gone haywire."

jp: 軍の上層部はそいつを制御し、あわよくば兵器転用するつもりだ。そこまでして一体何と戦うのかって？戦うためだけじゃない。利益になりそうなものがあれば取り入れたくなる。うちの民族の気質だな。
jp_grezzo: "軍の上層部はそいつを制御し、あわよくば兵器転用するつもりだ。そこまでして一体何と戦うのかって？戦うためだけじゃない。利益になりそうなものがあれば取り入れたくなる。うちの民族の気質だな。"
en: The ruins are being controlled by the upper echelons of the army, and they plan to militarize it if things go well. Do you wonder who would go so far for a weapon? But you see, it's not just for a weapon. If there is anything of that may be of benefit, we want to take it. That is the spirit of our nation.
en_grezzo: "The ruins are being controlled by the upper echelons of the army, and they plan to militarize it if things go well. Do you wonder who would go so far for a weapon? But you see, it's not just for a weapon. If there is anything of that may be of benefit, we want to take it. That is the spirit of our nation."

jp: 護衛の件で活躍しようものならお前も軍にスカウトされるだろうな。自由気ままに冒険を続けたいなら、遺跡にも軍にも取り込まれないよう注意することだ。
jp_grezzo: "護衛の件で活躍しようものならお前も軍にスカウトされるだろうな。自由気ままに冒険を続けたいなら、遺跡にも軍にも取り込まれないよう注意することだ。"
en: If you distinguish yourself as a bodyguard, then you too may be scouted by the military.
en_grezzo: "If you distinguish yourself as a bodyguard, then you too may be scouted by the military."

jp: 最下層にいる怪物はメシェーラの塊だ。貴重なサンプルだから滅ぼすのは少し惜しいが…。
jp_grezzo: "最下層にいる怪物はメシェーラの塊だ。貴重なサンプルだから滅ぼすのは少し惜しいが…。"
en: The monster on the bottom floor is a mass of Meshera. It's a precious specimen. It's a shame we have to destroy it...
en_grezzo: "The monster on the bottom floor is a mass of Meshera. It's a precious specimen. It's a shame we have to destroy it..."

jp: 一応お前の任務は調査部隊の護衛ってことになってるからな。早く行って追い付いたほうがいいと思うぞ。そうそう、遺跡で何か面白そうなものを見つけたら俺に教えてくれ。
jp_grezzo: "一応お前の任務は調査部隊の護衛ってことになってるからな。早く行って追い付いたほうがいいと思うぞ。そうそう、遺跡で何か面白そうなものを見つけたら俺に教えてくれ。"
en: You're nothing but a guard for the investigation team for now, so you should probably go catch up with them. Oh yes, and let me know if you find anything interesting in the ruins.
en_grezzo: "You're nothing but a guard for the investigation team for now, so you should probably go catch up with them. Oh yes, and let me know if you find anything interesting in the ruins."

jp: 任務ってほどじゃないが…手伝いをしてもらおうか。俺が指定したデータやサンプルを回収してきてくれ。軍が危険防止のために設けた電子ロック、そいつを解除できるカードキーを発行してやるからさ。
jp_grezzo: "任務ってほどじゃないが…手伝いをしてもらおうか。俺が指定したデータやサンプルを回収してきてくれ。軍が危険防止のために設けた電子ロック、そいつを解除できるカードキーを発行してやるからさ。"
en: It's not necessarily your duty, but... perhaps I'll have you lend me a hand. Please collect the data and retrieve the samples I have specified. If you do this for me, I'll give you a card key to get past the electronic lock on Remido.
en_grezzo: "It's not necessarily your duty, but... perhaps I'll have you lend me a hand. Please collect the data and retrieve the samples I have specified. If you do this for me, I'll give you a card key to get past the electronic lock on Remido."

jp: 湖の近辺にうちの軍が建造した機械要塞があるんだが、だいぶ前に地殻変動によってネフィアと融合してしまった。そして融合時のショックで制御システムが暴走したみたいでな、連絡もとれやしない。
jp_grezzo: "湖の近辺にうちの軍が建造した機械要塞があるんだが、だいぶ前に地殻変動によってネフィアと融合してしまった。そして融合時のショックで制御システムが暴走したみたいでな、連絡もとれやしない。"
en: There is a Machine Fortress that the Yerles military built near the lake to the southeast, but it has fused with a ruin of Nefia due to the crustal movement of the planet. When this fusion happened, it drove the control system haywire and we lost all contact with the fortress.
en_grezzo: "There is a Machine Fortress that the Yerles military built near the lake to the southeast, but it has fused with a ruin of Nefia due to the crustal movement of the planet. When this fusion happened, it drove the control system haywire and we lost all contact with the fortress."

jp: こちらも何度か兵士を送り込んだのだが、要塞の防衛システムに阻まれことごとく失敗してな。軍は要塞を破棄することにしたようだ。だが俺はどうしてもシステムに蓄積されたデータを回収したいのだ。もったいないからな。
jp_grezzo: "こちらも何度か兵士を送り込んだのだが、要塞の防衛システムに阻まれことごとく失敗してな。軍は要塞を破棄することにしたようだ。だが俺はどうしてもシステムに蓄積されたデータを回収したいのだ。もったいないからな。"
en: Troops have been sent in several times, but they've all been defeated by the fortress' defense systems. I absolutely cannot let the data accumulated by the system there go to waste.
en_grezzo: "Troops have been sent in several times, but they've all been defeated by the fortress' defense systems. I absolutely cannot let the data accumulated by the system there go to waste."

jp: そこでだ。要塞中枢に投げ出されていると思われる大型飛行兵器の頭部から、データチップを抜き取り持ってきてもらいたい。それ以外のパーツは好きにしてかまわんぞ。ちょっと加工すれば装備品にできるパーツもあるはずだしな。
jp_grezzo: "そこでだ。要塞中枢に投げ出されていると思われる大型飛行兵器の頭部から、データチップを抜き取り持ってきてもらいたい。それ以外のパーツは好きにしてかまわんぞ。ちょっと加工すれば装備品にできるパーツもあるはずだしな。"
en: So. There is a large flying weapon in the center of the fortress. I'd like for you to remove its data chip. Nothing else there is of any importance. If you're careful, you should even be able to salvage some equipment from the weapon.
en_grezzo: "So. There is a large flying weapon in the center of the fortress. I'd like for you to remove its data chip. Nothing else there is of any importance. If you're careful, you should even be able to salvage some equipment from the weapon."

jp: 北東の山岳地帯手前に、異形の者が支配する神殿がある。最深部には外法で強化されたモンスターどもが待ち受けているらしい。
jp_grezzo: "北東の山岳地帯手前に、異形の者が支配する神殿がある。最深部には外法で強化されたモンスターどもが待ち受けているらしい。"
en: Near the mountains to the northeast there is a Temple of Chaos. I expect that powerful enemies and the ruler of the Temple reside in its depths.
en_grezzo: "Near the mountains to the northeast there is a Temple of Chaos. I expect that powerful enemies and the ruler of the Temple reside in its depths."

jp: そこの親玉、《エグゾシズル》の翼を研究したくてな。ちょっと翼をもいできてくれ。６枚全部だぞ。
jp_grezzo: "そこの親玉、《エグゾシズル》の翼を研究したくてな。ちょっと翼をもいできてくれ。６枚全部だぞ。"
en: I want to study <Exossil> The Chaos Wing - the ruler of the place.
en_grezzo: "I want to study <Exossil> The Chaos Wing - the ruler of the place."

jp: 魔法のことはよくわからんが、色々と厄介な攻撃を仕掛けてくることが予想される。十分に注意しろ。
jp_grezzo: "魔法のことはよくわからんが、色々と厄介な攻撃を仕掛けてくることが予想される。十分に注意しろ。"
en: I don't know exactly what you should expect, but be prepared to defend yourself against powerful magic. Be careful.
en_grezzo: "I don't know exactly what you should expect, but be prepared to defend yourself against powerful magic. Be careful."

jp: サウスティリス極東の農村…ルードゥスのそのさらに東、ザナンとの国境近くの砂漠に、死者の眠る谷がある。階層こそ少ないが、表層には侵入者を惑わす罠が満載らしい。

en: The people don't seem to have gotten the message yet, but it might be a good idea to keep a low profile and go into hiding for a while until things cool down. By that time, I'm sure your reward will be ready.
en_grezzo: "The people don't seem to have gotten the message yet, but it might be a good idea to keep a low profile and go into hiding for a while until things cool down. By that time, I'm sure your reward will be ready."

jp: 決戦因子は君に決まったんだね。テスカトリポカが認めたなら大丈夫だろう。
jp_grezzo: "決戦因子は君に決まったんだね。テスカトリポカが認めたなら大丈夫だろう。"
en: So you've been chosen as the Decisive Factor. Given that Tezcatlipoca has recognized your prowess, I am confident that you will succeed.
en_grezzo: "So you've been chosen as the Decisive Factor. Given that Tezcatlipoca has recognized your prowess, I am confident that you will succeed."

jp: 仕方がない
jp_grezzo: "仕方がない"
en: I guess I have no choice.
en_grezzo: "I guess I have no choice."

jp: はい喜んで
jp_grezzo: "はい喜んで"
en: My pleasure.
en_grezzo: "My pleasure."

jp: 報酬は出るの？
jp_grezzo: "報酬は出るの？"
en: Will I be rewarded?
en_grezzo: "Will I be rewarded?"

jp: 嫌です
jp_grezzo: "嫌です"
en: I don't want to.
en_grezzo: "I don't want to."

jp: もし神の間が崩壊して混沌の神が出てきたら、神々も定命ももれなく混沌に取り込まれ、世界は蹂躙され全ての秩序は失われてしまうだろう。もちろん討伐を引き受けてくれるね？
jp_grezzo: "もし神の間が崩壊して混沌の神が出てきたら、神々も定命ももれなく混沌に取り込まれ、世界は蹂躙され全ての秩序は失われてしまうだろう。もちろん討伐を引き受けてくれるね？"
en: If the Eternal Seal collapses and the God of Chaos escapes, the gods and mortals will all be engulfed by Chaos, the world will be overrun, and all order will be lost. Of course, you'll be the one to to stop him, right?
en_grezzo: "If the Eternal Seal collapses and the God of Chaos escapes, the gods and mortals will all be engulfed by Chaos, the world will be overrun, and all order will be lost. Of course, you'll be the one to to stop him, right?"

jp: これは混沌から今の世界を守るためだからね。考え直してほしい。
jp_grezzo: "これは混沌から今の世界を守るためだからね。考え直してほしい。"
en: This is to protect the world from Chaos. I hope you'll reconsider.
en_grezzo: "This is to protect the world from Chaos. I hope you'll reconsider."

jp: さて…報酬はどうしようか。
jp_grezzo: "さて…報酬はどうしようか。"
en: Now then... About your reward.
en_grezzo: "Now then... About your reward."

jp: 富
en: Wealth.
en_grezzo: "Wealth."

jp: 名声
jp_grezzo: "名声"
en: Fame.
en_grezzo: "Fame."

jp: 強さ
jp_grezzo: "強さ"
en: Strength.
en_grezzo: "Strength."

jp: ハーレム
jp_grezzo: "ハーレム"
en: Harem.
en_grezzo: "Harem."

jp: 神の座
jp_grezzo: "神の座"
en: The seat of god.
en_grezzo: "The seat of god."

jp: おまえ
jp_grezzo: "おまえ"
en: You.
en_grezzo: "You."

jp: とりあえずアーティファクトはつけるとして…他に欲しいものがあるかな？
jp_grezzo: "とりあえずアーティファクトはつけるとして…他に欲しいものがあるかな？"
en: For now I'll include this artifact, so... Is anything else you want?
en_grezzo: "For now I'll include this artifact, so... Is anything else you want?"

jp: 神には神の仕事ルールがあってそれに縛られることになるよ。個神には大した権限もない。自由と引き換えてでも秩序維持のために働きたいのなら話は別だけど、それでも君の一生を全うしてからの方がいいだろうね。とにかくおすすめしないね。
jp_grezzo: "神には神の仕事ルールがあってそれに縛られることになるよ。個神には大した権限もない。自由と引き換えてでも秩序維持のために働きたいのなら話は別だけど、それでも君の一生を全うしてからの方がいいだろうね。とにかくおすすめしないね。"
en: Gods have their own set of business rules, and you'd be subject to following them. Individual gods don't have much authority - that is, unless you want to continually work to maintain order in exchange for your freedom. But even then, it's probably better to wait until you've lived your whole life before deciding to sit in god's chair. Anyway, I wouldn't recommend it.
en_grezzo: "Gods have their own set of business rules, and you'd be subject to following them. Individual gods don't have much authority - that is, unless you want to continually work to maintain order in exchange for your freedom. But even then, it's probably better to wait until you've lived your whole life before deciding to sit in god's chair. Anyway, I wouldn't recommend it."

jp: そんなことを言って、相手の反応が知りたいだけだろう？そのくらいは本で読んで知っているよ。神をからかってはいけないね。
jp_grezzo: "そんなことを言って、相手の反応が知りたいだけだろう？そのくらいは本で読んで知っているよ。神をからかってはいけないね。"
en: You're just saying that to see how I'd react, right? I know that much from reading a few books. You shouldn't poke fun at a god, you know.
en_grezzo: "You're just saying that to see how I'd react, right? I know that much from reading a few books. You shouldn't poke fun at a god, you know."

jp: なるほど…覚えておくね。
jp_grezzo: "なるほど…覚えておくね。"
en: I see... I'll keep that in mind.
en_grezzo: "I see... I'll keep that in mind."

jp: 話は変わるけれど、混沌の神を倒すための道具を渡しておこう。
jp_grezzo: "話は変わるけれど、混沌の神を倒すための道具を渡しておこう。"
en: To change the subject, I'll give you the tools you'll need in order to defeat the God of Chaos.
en_grezzo: "To change the subject, I'll give you the tools you'll need in order to defeat the God of Chaos."

jp: [来光の牙]を手に入れた！
jp_grezzo: "[来光の牙]を手に入れた！"
en: You obtain the [Origin of Light]!
en_grezzo: "You obtain the [Origin of Light]!"

jp: いくら弱っているとはいえ、相手は私達より圧倒的に高い存在級位を有している。物理的にいくら殺しても倒したことにならない。あれほどの存在をアカシックレコードから切り離すには、膨大なアストラル光が必要になるんだ。
jp_grezzo: "いくら弱っているとはいえ、相手は私達より圧倒的に高い存在級位を有している。物理的にいくら殺しても倒したことにならない。あれほどの存在をアカシックレコードから切り離すには、膨大なアストラル光が必要になるんだ。"
en: No matter how weak he is, our adversary still possesses a level of existence that is overwhelmingly stronger than ours. No matter how many times we kill him physically, we will never truly be able to defeat him. It would take an enormous amount of astral light to separate a being of that magnitude from the Akashic Records.
en_grezzo: "No matter how weak he is, our adversary still possesses a level of existence that is overwhelmingly stronger than ours. No matter how many times we kill him physically, we will never truly be able to defeat him. It would take an enormous amount of astral light to separate a being of that magnitude from the Akashic Records."

jp: そこで、混沌の神を殺す瞬間…すなわち、相手の存在が最も揺らぐ瞬間に神々全員の神力をマナに逆変換して来光の牙に送る。来光の牙はマナをアストラル光に変換するための装置なんだ。発生したアストラル光によって、奴のアカシックレコードに完全干渉する。
jp_grezzo: "そこで、混沌の神を殺す瞬間…すなわち、相手の存在が最も揺らぐ瞬間に神々全員の神力をマナに逆変換して来光の牙に送る。来光の牙はマナをアストラル光に変換するための装置なんだ。発生したアストラル光によって、奴のアカシックレコードに完全干渉する。"
en: So, the moment we kill the God of Chaos... that is, the moment when his existence is most shaken, we will convert the divine power of all the gods back into mana and send it all to the Origin of Light. The Origin of Light is a device that converts mana into astral light. The astral light that is generated will completely interfere with his Akashic Records.
en_grezzo: "So, the moment we kill the God of Chaos... that is, the moment when his existence is most shaken, we will convert the divine power of all the gods back into mana and send it all to the Origin of Light. The Origin of Light is a device that converts mana into astral light. The astral light that is generated will completely interfere with his Akashic Records."

jp: …簡単に説明すると、トドメの際に突き刺せば、完全に消滅させるなり、無力化したうえで闇檻に放り込むなりで処理できるということだね。この突破法の準備に3000年かかったから失敗しないでほしいね。
jp_grezzo: "…簡単に説明すると、トドメの際に突き刺せば、完全に消滅させるなり、無力化したうえで闇檻に放り込むなりで処理できるということだね。この突破法の準備に3000年かかったから失敗しないでほしいね。"
en: ...In other words, if you can strike the God of Chaos during that window of opportunity, you can incapacitate or even completely obliterate him, then lock him in the prison of darkness for good. It took me 3,000 years to prepare this breakthrough strategy, so I certainly hope you won't fail.
en_grezzo: "...In other words, if you can strike the God of Chaos during that window of opportunity, you can incapacitate or even completely obliterate him, then lock him in the prison of darkness for good. It took me 3,000 years to prepare this breakthrough strategy, so I certainly hope you won't fail."

jp: …そうだ。あと、これも必要なら持っていくといい。
jp_grezzo: "…そうだ。あと、これも必要なら持っていくといい。"
en: ...Oh, and you can take this with you as well, if you'll be needing it.
en_grezzo: "...Oh, and you can take this with you as well, if you'll be needing it."

jp: 神の間の物理崩壊は時間の問題だし、混沌の軍勢も勢力を増してきている。君も準備を整えてほしい。
jp_grezzo: "神の間の物理崩壊は時間の問題だし、混沌の軍勢も勢力を増してきている。君も準備を整えてほしい。"
en: The physical collapse of the Eternal Seal is only a matter of time, and the forces of Chaos are growing stronger as we speak. I hope you'll be ready.
en_grezzo: "The physical collapse of the Eternal Seal is only a matter of time, and the forces of Chaos are growing stronger as we speak. I hope you'll be ready."

jp: 神の間とは？
jp_grezzo: "神の間とは？"
en: What is \"The Eternal Seal\"?
en_grezzo: "What is \"The Eternal Seal\"?"

jp: 神々の大戦とは？
jp_grezzo: "神々の大戦とは？"
en: What is the \"War of the Gods\"?
en_grezzo: "What is the \"War of the Gods\"?"

jp: 何か手伝えることは？
jp_grezzo: "何か手伝えることは？"
en: Is there any way I can help you out?
en_grezzo: "Is there any way I can help you out?"

jp: スリーサイズは？
jp_grezzo: "スリーサイズは？"
en: What are your three sizes?
en_grezzo: "What are your three sizes?"

jp: 混沌の神の正体は？
jp_grezzo: "混沌の神の正体は？"
en: What is the true identity of the God of Chaos?
en_grezzo: "What is the true identity of the God of Chaos?"

jp: これまでの経緯をまとめて知りたい
jp_grezzo: "これまでの経緯をまとめて知りたい"
en: I want to know the whole story up to this point.
en_grezzo: "I want to know the whole story up to this point."

jp: 混沌の神を倒したらネフィアはどうなる？
jp_grezzo: "混沌の神を倒したらネフィアはどうなる？"
en: Once we defeat the God of Chaos, what happens to Nefia?
en_grezzo: "Once we defeat the God of Chaos, what happens to Nefia?"

jp: ネフィアの永遠の盟約により、全てを話すことはできないね。しかし、制限されていない情報に関しては君にも教えよう。
jp_grezzo: "ネフィアの永遠の盟約により、全てを話すことはできないね。しかし、制限されていない情報に関しては君にも教えよう。"
en: To comply with the Eternal League of Nefia, I cannot tell you everything I know. However, I can provide you with some information that is not under restriction.
en_grezzo: "To comply with the Eternal League of Nefia, I cannot tell you everything I know. However, I can provide you with some information that is not under restriction."

jp: …そうだね。あまり言いたくないけれど、あれと戦う君には知る権利があるね。
jp_grezzo: "…そうだね。あまり言いたくないけれど、あれと戦う君には知る権利があるね。"
en: ...That's right. I do not want to say too much, but since you're the one who's about to go to battle, you have a right to know.
en_grezzo: "...That's right. I do not want to say too much, but since you're the one who's about to go to battle, you have a right to know."

jp: 混沌の神…エンテュメイシス。その正体は…もう一人の私なんだ。
jp_grezzo: "混沌の神…エンテュメイシス。その正体は…もう一人の私なんだ。"
en: The God of Chaos... Enthumesis. That identity... is my other self.
en_grezzo: "The God of Chaos... Enthumesis. That identity... is my other self."

jp: わが父、《深淵のプロパトル》は至高の超越者だった。神としても次元が違うため知覚できないほどのね。末娘だった私は兄や姉に尋ねたが一切の情報が不明。「誰にも知ることができない神」と言っても過言じゃない…。
jp_grezzo: "わが父、《深淵のプロパトル》は至高の超越者だった。神としても次元が違うため知覚できないほどのね。末娘だった私は兄や姉に尋ねたが一切の情報が不明。「誰にも知ることができない神」と言っても過言じゃない…。"
en: My father, \"Prophatorl of The Abyss\", was the greatest transcendent of them all. Even as a god, he was imperceptible because he existed in a different dimension from ours. As the youngest daughter out of my siblings, I asked my older brothers and sisters, but they knew nothing about him. It's no exaggeration to say that he was the \"god that no one could ever know\"...
en_grezzo: "My father, \"Prophatorl of The Abyss\", was the greatest transcendent of them all. Even as a god, he was imperceptible because he existed in a different dimension from ours. As the youngest daughter out of my siblings, I asked my older brothers and sisters, but they knew nothing about him. It's no exaggeration to say that he was the \"god that no one could ever know\"..."

jp: それでも…当時の私はどうしても父のことを知りたかった。知識欲の強い娘が、行方不明の父のことを調べようと思うのは仕方がないことだったと思う。
jp_grezzo: "それでも…当時の私はどうしても父のことを知りたかった。知識欲の強い娘が、行方不明の父のことを調べようと思うのは仕方がないことだったと思う。"
en: Even so... at the time, I really wanted to know more about my father. I think it was inevitable that a daughter with such a strong desire for knowledge would want to find out about her missing father.
en_grezzo: "Even so... at the time, I really wanted to know more about my father. I think it was inevitable that a daughter with such a strong desire for knowledge would want to find out about her missing father."

jp: 知りたいのに知ることができないジレンマが頂点に達した時、暴走した想いが私の中にエンテュメイシスという穢れた人格を作り出した。魂の穢れた私は堕天して地上を彷徨っていたが、兄姉の精神浄化によってエンテュメイシスを分離して帰還することができた。今では父のことを知ろうなんて気持ちは微塵もないね。
jp_grezzo: "知りたいのに知ることができないジレンマが頂点に達した時、暴走した想いが私の中にエンテュメイシスという穢れた人格を作り出した。魂の穢れた私は堕天して地上を彷徨っていたが、兄姉の精神浄化によってエンテュメイシスを分離して帰還することができた。今では父のことを知ろうなんて気持ちは微塵もないね。"
en: When my dilemma of wanting to know but not being able to finally reached its peak, my runaway thoughts created an unholy personality within me called Enthumesis. My soul was corrupted and I wandered the earth, but through the spiritual purification I received from my siblings, I was able to separate myself from Enthumesis and return to the heavens. Nowadays, I no longer have even the slightest desire to learn anything more about my father.
en_grezzo: "When my dilemma of wanting to know but not being able to finally reached its peak, my runaway thoughts created an unholy personality within me called Enthumesis. My soul was corrupted and I wandered the earth, but through the spiritual purification I received from my siblings, I was able to separate myself from Enthumesis and return to the heavens. Nowadays, I no longer have even the slightest desire to learn anything more about my father."

jp: だがエンテュメイシスは私から分離した後も実は消えずに活動していたんだ。人間たちには不死で知りたがりの娼婦として扱われていたようだね。とりあえずは無害だと判断されていたのだけれど、神々の大戦中、エンテュメイシスは牙を剥いた。
jp_grezzo: "だがエンテュメイシスは私から分離した後も実は消えずに活動していたんだ。人間たちには不死で知りたがりの娼婦として扱われていたようだね。とりあえずは無害だと判断されていたのだけれど、神々の大戦中、エンテュメイシスは牙を剥いた。"
en: But actually, Enthumesis was still active after I separated from them. It seems that the humans treated them as an immortal harlot with an unending thirst for knowledge. For the time being, they were deemed harmless, but during the War of the Gods, Enthumesis revealed their true nature.
en_grezzo: "But actually, Enthumesis was still active after I separated from them. It seems that the humans treated them as an immortal harlot with an unending thirst for knowledge. For the time being, they were deemed harmless, but during the War of the Gods, Enthumesis revealed their true nature."

jp: あれはまるで本から知識を取り込むかのように、大戦で傷ついた神々を次々と吸収していった。父についての情報を得るため、そして力を蓄えて同じ高次元に立とうとしたんだね。熱いパトスのおもむくまま、むやみやたらと神の力を混ぜ合わせていった結果、両性具有の混沌神となってしまった。
jp_grezzo: "あれはまるで本から知識を取り込むかのように、大戦で傷ついた神々を次々と吸収していった。父についての情報を得るため、そして力を蓄えて同じ高次元に立とうとしたんだね。熱いパトスのおもむくまま、むやみやたらと神の力を混ぜ合わせていった結果、両性具有の混沌神となってしまった。"
en: They absorbed the gods wounded in the Great War one after another, as if taking in knowledge from some books. They were trying to gain information about my father, and to stand on the same higher plane as him by accumulating enough power. As a result of that hot pathos, they recklessly mixed the power of the gods together, and as a result became a chaotic god of both sexes.
en_grezzo: "They absorbed the gods wounded in the Great War one after another, as if taking in knowledge from some books. They were trying to gain information about my father, and to stand on the same higher plane as him by accumulating enough power. As a result of that hot pathos, they recklessly mixed the power of the gods together, and as a result became a chaotic god of both sexes."

jp: エンテュメイシスは封印される間際でも父を求めていたよ。混沌の眷属が人間を取り込もうとするのも、根底にあるのは知識欲なのかもしれないね…。
jp_grezzo: "エンテュメイシスは封印される間際でも父を求めていたよ。混沌の眷属が人間を取り込もうとするのも、根底にあるのは知識欲なのかもしれないね…。"
en: Enthumesis was still seeking their father when they were about to be sealed away. Perhaps it is that desire for knowledge that lies at the root of the servants of Chaos' desire to possess humans....
en_grezzo: "Enthumesis was still seeking their father when they were about to be sealed away. Perhaps it is that desire for knowledge that lies at the root of the servants of Chaos' desire to possess humans...."

jp: じゃあ簡単に、かいつまんで。
jp_grezzo: "じゃあ簡単に、かいつまんで。"
en: Okay, so I'll briefly recap.
en_grezzo: "Okay, so I'll briefly recap."

jp: 1。長い歴史の中で、人類は神は徐々に必要としなくなり、神は力を失いつつあった。
jp_grezzo: "1。長い歴史の中で、人類は神は徐々に必要としなくなり、神は力を失いつつあった。"
en: 1. Over the course of history, humanity has gradually outgrown the need for God, and the gods have been losing their power.
en_grezzo: "1. Over the course of history, humanity has gradually outgrown the need for God, and the gods have been losing their power."

jp: 2。そんな時、人類の大半が宇宙に旅立ってしまった。
jp_grezzo: "2。そんな時、人類の大半が宇宙に旅立ってしまった。"
en: 2. At that point in time, the majority of humankind had left for the cosmos.
en_grezzo: "2. At that point in time, the majority of humankind had left for the cosmos."

jp: 3。存在の危うくなった神々が殺気立つ中、テスカトリポカが他の神を倒して信者を奪った。
jp_grezzo: "3。存在の危うくなった神々が殺気立つ中、テスカトリポカが他の神を倒して信者を奪った。"
en: 3. As the gods were seething with anger, seeing their existence endangered, Tezcatlipoca defeats them all and claims their followers.
en_grezzo: "3. As the gods were seething with anger, seeing their existence endangered, Tezcatlipoca defeats them all and claims their followers."

jp: 4。神々の生存競争が勃発。多くの神が消滅したり魔物に堕ちた。
jp_grezzo: "4。神々の生存競争が勃発。多くの神が消滅したり魔物に堕ちた。"
en: 4. A war of life and death breaks out between the gods. Many of them disappear or fall to demonic powers.
en_grezzo: "4. A war of life and death breaks out between the gods. Many of them disappear or fall to demonic powers."

jp: 5。大戦の裏で混沌の神が力をつけていたことが発覚。混沌対神々の構図に変化。
jp_grezzo: "5。大戦の裏で混沌の神が力をつけていたことが発覚。混沌対神々の構図に変化。"
en: 5. It is found that the gods of Chaos have been gaining power in the backdrop of the Great War. The nature of the battle changes to that of Chaos versus the gods.
en_grezzo: "5. It is found that the gods of Chaos have been gaining power in the backdrop of the Great War. The nature of the battle changes to that of Chaos versus the gods."

jp: 6。激戦の末混沌の神は封印できたがこの時混沌の精霊の種が蒔かれていた。

jp_grezzo: "12。混沌の神から奪った力を還元し、ネフィア誕生。"
en: 12. The power stolen from the God of Chaos is returned to the land, and Nefia is born.
en_grezzo: "12. The power stolen from the God of Chaos is returned to the land, and Nefia is born."

en_grezzo: "14. The Eternal Seal falls into decay once again."

jp: 15。人工細菌メサイアによって作られた秩序の一角獣が役目を果たす。後にサーペントに取り込まれてカオス・ユニコーンへ変化したことが判明。
jp_grezzo: "15。人工細菌メサイアによって作られた秩序の一角獣が役目を果たす。後にサーペントに取り込まれてカオス・ユニコーンへ変化したことが判明。"
en: 15. The Unicorn of Order, created by the artificial bacterium Messia, fulfills its purpose. It is later revealed that it was possessed by the Serpent and transformed into the Chaos Unicorn.
en_grezzo: "15. The Unicorn of Order, created by the artificial bacterium Messia, fulfills its purpose. It is later revealed that it was possessed by the Serpent and transformed into the Chaos Unicorn."

jp_grezzo: "16。エーテルが発見され、はみ出し者たちによって盛んに採取された。"

en_grezzo: "16. Ether is discovered, and it is harvested extensively by the outcast population."

jp_grezzo: "17。メサイアが事故で変異・流出しメシェーラと呼ばれるように。エーテル減少で弱っていた環境は激変。"

en_grezzo: "17. Messia mutates and escapes containment in an accident, and becomes known as Meshera. The environment, having already been weakened by the depletion of Ether, undergoes drastic changes."

jp_grezzo: "18。環境変化に耐え切れずレム・イド滅亡。人類はシェルターで細々と暮らす程度に。"
en: 18. The population of Rehm-Ido, unable to adapt to the rapidly changing environment, is wiped out. Humanity is reduced to living meager lives in shelters.
en_grezzo: "18. The population of Rehm-Ido, unable to adapt to the rapidly changing environment, is wiped out. Humanity is reduced to living meager lives in shelters."

jp: 19。メシェーラに侵食された超生物やアンデッド兵器が荒野を徘徊する、永い暗黒期の到来。
jp_grezzo: "19。メシェーラに侵食された超生物やアンデッド兵器が荒野を徘徊する、永い暗黒期の到来。"
en: 19. A long, dark chapter in history arrives, in which Meshera-infested super-beings and undead weapons of destruction roam the wilderness.
en_grezzo: "19. A long, dark chapter in history arrives, in which Meshera-infested super-beings and undead weapons of destruction roam the wilderness."

jp: 20。年月経過で回復したエーテルが風を生みヴィンデールの森が発達。
jp_grezzo: "20。年月経過で回復したエーテルが風を生みヴィンデールの森が発達。"

en_grezzo: "20. The natural reserve of Ether that has been gradually recovering over the years causes a wind to blow, and the forest of Vindale develops."

jp_grezzo: "21。メシェーラ環境に適応できる人類が生まれ世界に拡散。シエラ・テール誕生。"

en_grezzo: "21. Humans capable of adapting to the Meshera-infested environment are born, and spread throughout the world. Sierre Terre is formed."

jp: 22。常闇の杖が完成しオルフェ発見。監視を開始。
jp_grezzo: "22。常闇の杖が完成しオルフェ発見。監視を開始。"
en: 22. The Origin of Vice is completed and Orphe is discovered. He is promptly put under surveillance.
en_grezzo: "22. The Origin of Vice is completed and Orphe is discovered. He is promptly put under surveillance."

jp: 23。さらに回復したエーテルがヴィンデールの森を拡大。カルーン滅亡。
jp_grezzo: "23。さらに回復したエーテルがヴィンデールの森を拡大。カルーン滅亡。"
en: 23. Further restoration of Ether expands the forest of Vindale. Karune is destroyed.
en_grezzo: "23. Further restoration of Ether expands the forest of Vindale. Karune is destroyed."

jp: 24。ヴィンデールの森が焼き払われる。
jp_grezzo: "24。ヴィンデールの森が焼き払われる。"
en: 24. The forest of Vindale is burned to the ground.
en_grezzo: "24. The forest of Vindale is burned to the ground."

jp: 25。神の間が再度老朽化。潜伏していた混沌の軍勢も活発に。
jp_grezzo: "25。神の間が再度老朽化。潜伏していた混沌の軍勢も活発に。"
en: 25. The Eternal Seal falls into decay once more. The forces of Chaos that had once been dormant start to awaken.
en_grezzo: "25. The Eternal Seal falls into decay once more. The forces of Chaos that had once been dormant start to awaken."

jp: そして、強さと抵抗力を兼ね備えた君が決戦因子として選ばれた…というわけだね。
jp_grezzo: "そして、強さと抵抗力を兼ね備えた君が決戦因子として選ばれた…というわけだね。"
en: And so, with your combination of strength and resilience, you have been chosen as the Decisive Factor in this imminent battle.
en_grezzo: "And so, with your combination of strength and resilience, you have been chosen as the Decisive Factor in this imminent battle."

jp: いい質問だね。現在のネフィアは混沌の神から奪った力を魔力に変換後、陽牢の塔を経由して龍脈に流し込んで生成している。つまり混沌の神がいなくなったらネフィアは維持できなくなるね。
jp_grezzo: "いい質問だね。現在のネフィアは混沌の神から奪った力を魔力に変換後、陽牢の塔を経由して龍脈に流し込んで生成している。つまり混沌の神がいなくなったらネフィアは維持できなくなるね。"
en: That's a good question. Currently, Nefia are generated by converting the power taken from the God of Chaos into magical power, and then channeling it into the Dragon Vein via the Mirage Tower. In other words, if the God of Chaos were to disappear, Nefia would also cease to exist.
en_grezzo: "That's a good question. Currently, Nefia are generated by converting the power taken from the God of Chaos into magical power, and then channeling it into the Dragon Vein via the Mirage Tower. In other words, if the God of Chaos were to disappear, Nefia would also cease to exist."

jp: ただし、すぐにネフィアが消えるわけじゃないよ。ネフィアのベースとなる遺跡はまた8億程ストックがあるし、魔力も現在対流している分が枯渇するのに最低2000年かかる。それまでに定命も神もネフィアに依存しないシステムを構築していく必要があるね。
jp_grezzo: "ただし、すぐにネフィアが消えるわけじゃないよ。ネフィアのベースとなる遺跡はまた8億程ストックがあるし、魔力も現在対流している分が枯渇するのに最低2000年かかる。それまでに定命も神もネフィアに依存しないシステムを構築していく必要があるね。"
en: But that doesn't mean that Nefia will disappear anytime soon. There are over 800 million ruins in the world that can be used as a base for Nefia, and it will take at least 2,000 years for the current amount of magical power in the atmosphere to be depleted. By that time, we'd need to build a new system that doesn't depend on destiny or gods or Nefia.
en_grezzo: "But that doesn't mean that Nefia will disappear anytime soon. There are over 800 million ruins in the world that can be used as a base for Nefia, and it will take at least 2,000 years for the current amount of magical power in the atmosphere to be depleted. By that time, we'd need to build a new system that doesn't depend on destiny or gods or Nefia."

jp: 神の間は混沌の神が封じられている場所だね。神の間の役割は張り巡らされた結界によって混沌の神の力を奪うことだ。
jp_grezzo: "神の間は混沌の神が封じられている場所だね。神の間の役割は張り巡らされた結界によって混沌の神の力を奪うことだ。"
en: The Eternal Seal is where the God of Chaos is sealed. As part of their role, the gods were forced to extend a barrier that should consequently steal the God of Chaos' power.
en_grezzo: "The Eternal Seal is where the God of Chaos is sealed. As part of their role, the gods were forced to extend a barrier that should consequently steal the God of Chaos' power."

jp: やがて奪った力はネフィアを生む魔力へと変換してイルヴァ全土に拡散されることになった。こうして世界に混沌と魔法の力がもたらされることになるわけだが…。それはまた別のお話だね。
jp_grezzo: "やがて奪った力はネフィアを生む魔力へと変換してイルヴァ全土に拡散されることになった。こうして世界に混沌と魔法の力がもたらされることになるわけだが…。それはまた別のお話だね。"
en: In the end this energy was spread throughout the world and converted into the magic that produces the ruins of Nefia. It was in this way that magic and Chaos was brought to the land of Irva... But that's a story for another time.
en_grezzo: "In the end this energy was spread throughout the world and converted into the magic that produces the ruins of Nefia. It was in this way that magic and Chaos was brought to the land of Irva... But that's a story for another time."

jp: そもそもの始まりは、神を必要としないまでに人の技術が発達したことだった。その極限にしてエイス・テールの前身…アース・テールと呼ばれる文明。もはやこの星に納まる存在でなくなった当時の人類は、わずかばかりの民を残して星の海に旅立っていった。
jp_grezzo: "そもそもの始まりは、神を必要としないまでに人の技術が発達したことだった。その極限にしてエイス・テールの前身…アース・テールと呼ばれる文明。もはやこの星に納まる存在でなくなった当時の人類は、わずかばかりの民を残して星の海に旅立っていった。"
en: Long ago, human technology developed to the point where the gods were no longer needed. This development reached its breaking point in the era preceding Eyth Terre... Asu Terre. Human civilization grew to the point that this planet could no longer support them, and the majority left for the stars.
en_grezzo: "Long ago, human technology developed to the point where the gods were no longer needed. This development reached its breaking point in the era preceding Eyth Terre... Asu Terre. Human civilization grew to the point that this planet could no longer support them, and the majority left for the stars."

jp: それまでに信仰が絶えかけ力が衰えていた神々にとって、人類の旅立ちは存在を危うくするほどの一大事。残された定命たちに力を誇示し信仰を確保せねば、神としての存在を維持することができないと誰もが考えていたね…。
jp_grezzo: "それまでに信仰が絶えかけ力が衰えていた神々にとって、人類の旅立ちは存在を危うくするほどの一大事。残された定命たちに力を誇示し信仰を確保せねば、神としての存在を維持することができないと誰もが考えていたね…。"
en: For the gods - whose power had already greatly diminished due to a lack of believers - this development threatened their very existence. They felt that unless they made a show of power to gain the faith of those left behind, they would be unable to maintain their existence as gods...
en_grezzo: "For the gods - whose power had already greatly diminished due to a lack of believers - this development threatened their very existence. They felt that unless they made a show of power to gain the faith of those left behind, they would be unable to maintain their existence as gods..."

jp: そしてテスカトリポカによる虐殺が引き金となり、神々の生存戦争が始まったんだ。あの時のイルヴァには、秩序などなかったね…。
jp_grezzo: "そしてテスカトリポカによる虐殺が引き金となり、神々の生存戦争が始まったんだ。あの時のイルヴァには、秩序などなかったね…。"
en: Tazcatlipoca started the slaughter, and so the war for the survival of the gods began. Irva fell into complete Chaos...
en_grezzo: "Tazcatlipoca started the slaughter, and so the war for the survival of the gods began. Irva fell into complete Chaos..."

jp: おかえり…。叡智の結晶であるこの書物は、大戦の末期に台座ごと人界に持ち去られ、ずっと行方がわからなくなっていた。すっかり魔力を失ってしまったようだけど…それでもこの上なく貴重な資料であることに変わりはないね。

It appears to have completely lost its magic, but... Even so, that does not alter its status as the most precious tome.
en_grezzo: "You've returned to us at last... At the end of the Great War, this tome of knowledge - pedestal and all - was taken into the human world, and its location has been lost to us since. jp: 君か…また…会ったな。あれから私はアクセス端末に細工して仲間の大半を行動不能にし、その隙に船の動力部と中枢を修復不能なまでに破壊した。無我夢中だったもので、少し…いや、かなりやりすぎてしまった。…まいったな、どうやら私には資源回収より破壊工作のほうが合っていたようだ。
jp_grezzo: "君か…また…会ったな。あれから私はアクセス端末に細工して仲間の大半を行動不能にし、その隙に船の動力部と中枢を修復不能なまでに破壊した。無我夢中だったもので、少し…いや、かなりやりすぎてしまった。…まいったな、どうやら私には資源回収より破壊工作のほうが合っていたようだ。"
en: We... We meet again. Since last time, I've modified most of the access terminals to lock out my companions, and damaged the control center and power systems beyond repair. I go so caught up in it that I... Yes, I think I went too far... I can't stand it. It seems that somehow I'm more suited for destructive work than resource recovery after all.
en_grezzo: "We... We meet again. Since last time, I've modified most of the access terminals to lock out my companions, and damaged the control center and power systems beyond repair. I go so caught up in it that I... Yes, I think I went too far... I can't stand it. It seems that somehow I'm more suited for destructive work than resource recovery after all."

jp: もう星には帰れない、そもそも帰る文明が存在しているのかさえわからない。残った仲間たちは相変わらず説得を聞いてくれず、私を処分しようとする。もう疲れた。
jp_grezzo: "もう星には帰れない、そもそも帰る文明が存在しているのかさえわからない。残った仲間たちは相変わらず説得を聞いてくれず、私を処分しようとする。もう疲れた。"
en: I don't know if the planet I came from still exists, but I can no longer return. The few of my companions that remained still refused to listen and tried to dispose of me. I'm so tired...
en_grezzo: "I don't know if the planet I came from still exists, but I can no longer return. The few of my companions that remained still refused to listen and tried to dispose of me. I'm so tired..."

jp: 突破口を開いてくれたか、感謝する！これはささやかだがお礼だ。この星でどれだけの価値があるかはわからないが…不要でなければ受け取ってほしい。
jp_grezzo: "突破口を開いてくれたか、感謝する！これはささやかだがお礼だ。この星でどれだけの価値があるかはわからないが…不要でなければ受け取ってほしい。"
en: Thank you for clearing a path for me! It's not much, but please take this. I don't know how valuable it will be on this planet, but... I want you to have it.
en_grezzo: "Thank you for clearing a path for me! It's not much, but please take this. I don't know how valuable it will be on this planet, but... I want you to have it."

jp: 私はこれから船に乗り込んで始末をつけてくる。仲間たちの妨害があるだろうが、宇宙生物に比べればなんとでもなるレベルだ。そこまで君に頼むわけにはいかない。
jp_grezzo: "私はこれから船に乗り込んで始末をつけてくる。仲間たちの妨害があるだろうが、宇宙生物に比べればなんとでもなるレベルだ。そこまで君に頼むわけにはいかない。"
en: I'll go and take care of shutting down the ship now. My companions may try to interfere, but they're nothing compared to those space creatures. I will handle them myself... I couldn't ask you to do any more.
en_grezzo: "I'll go and take care of shutting down the ship now. My companions may try to interfere, but they're nothing compared to those space creatures. I will handle them myself... I couldn't ask you to do any more."

jp: さらばだ、異星の友人よ。本当に迷惑をかけたな。
jp_grezzo: "さらばだ、異星の友人よ。本当に迷惑をかけたな。"
en: Farewell, my friend. I am truly sorry to have caused you so much trouble.
en_grezzo: "Farewell, my friend. I am truly sorry to have caused you so much trouble."

jp: 我々の乗ってきた船はこの塔から南東に存在するが、船のシステムを止めるには中枢へ辿りつかなくてはならない。しかしそのためには、戦闘用に調整された宇宙生物が防衛している区画をどうしても通らなければならないのだ。宇宙生物を排除してもらえれば、後は私がこの全機能を賭して始末をつけてみせよう。
jp_grezzo: "我々の乗ってきた船はこの塔から南東に存在するが、船のシステムを止めるには中枢へ辿りつかなくてはならない。しかしそのためには、戦闘用に調整された宇宙生物が防衛している区画をどうしても通らなければならないのだ。宇宙生物を排除してもらえれば、後は私がこの全機能を賭して始末をつけてみせよう。"
en: Our ship is located to the southeast of this tower. You must reach the control room at the center to shut down the ship's systems. But to reach this area, you must pass through a section guarded by reprogrammed creatures from space. If you can eliminate the creatures, I will come behind you and take care of the rest.
en_grezzo: "Our ship is located to the southeast of this tower. You must reach the control room at the center to shut down the ship's systems. But to reach this area, you must pass through a section guarded by reprogrammed creatures from space. If you can eliminate the creatures, I will come behind you and take care of the rest."

jp: そうそう、正面の入り口は当然封鎖されている。私は廃品から作り上げた爆発物で廃棄処理区画の壁と天井に穴を開けて出てきた。場所を教える、そこを入り口として侵入してくれ。
jp_grezzo: "そうそう、正面の入り口は当然封鎖されている。私は廃品から作り上げた爆発物で廃棄処理区画の壁と天井に穴を開けて出てきた。場所を教える、そこを入り口として侵入してくれ。"
en: Oh, and the entrance is blocked too of course. I used materials I found in the disposal area to create bombs and blast my way out of the ship. Let me tell you where the holes are so that you can enter that way.
en_grezzo: "Oh, and the entrance is blocked too of course. I used materials I found in the disposal area to create bombs and blast my way out of the ship. Let me tell you where the holes are so that you can enter that way."

jp: 星渡の収穫船の入り口について教えてもらった。
jp_grezzo: "星渡の収穫船の入り口について教えてもらった。"
en: You receive information on how to enter the ship.
en_grezzo: "You receive information on how to enter the ship."

jp: ああ
jp_grezzo: "ああ"
en: Sure.
en_grezzo: "Sure."

jp: いや…
jp_grezzo: "いや…"
en: I'll pass...
en_grezzo: "I'll pass..."

jp: おお…君は私の話を聞いてくれるのか？
jp_grezzo: "おお…君は私の話を聞いてくれるのか？"
en: Ah... Would you listen to my story?
en_grezzo: "Ah... Would you listen to my story?"

jp: 単刀直入に言おう。この星は狙われている。
jp_grezzo: "単刀直入に言おう。この星は狙われている。"
en: I'll be blunt. This planet is being targeted.
en_grezzo: "I'll be blunt. This planet is being targeted."

jp: 私は資源回収用に造られた機械生命体。メモリーによれば造物主たちに代わって遥かなる星の海を渡り、異星から資源を持ち帰るのが使命なのだが…
jp_grezzo: "私は資源回収用に造られた機械生命体。メモリーによれば造物主たちに代わって遥かなる星の海を渡り、異星から資源を持ち帰るのが使命なのだが…"
en: I am a mechanical lifeform designed for resource extraction. If my data is without error, my creator sent me from a distant planet on a mission to explore and bring back resources from other planets.
en_grezzo: "I am a mechanical lifeform designed for resource extraction. If my data is without error, my creator sent me from a distant planet on a mission to explore and bring back resources from other planets."

jp: 私が再起動したとき、万年単位で計測可能な計器が振り切れていた。通信装置も故障はしていないはずなのだが応答が無く、いったいどれだけの年月が過ぎたのか、造物主たちが今存命しているのかさえ不明な状況だ。
jp_grezzo: "私が再起動したとき、万年単位で計測可能な計器が振り切れていた。通信装置も故障はしていないはずなのだが応答が無く、いったいどれだけの年月が過ぎたのか、造物主たちが今存命しているのかさえ不明な状況だ。"
en: However, after my reactivation I noticed that my instruments to measure the passage of time had stopped at 10,000 years. My transmission equipment is without error yet my communications receive no response, The amount of time that has passed - and whether my creator is even still alive - is unknown.
en_grezzo: "However, after my reactivation I noticed that my instruments to measure the passage of time had stopped at 10,000 years. My transmission equipment is without error yet my communications receive no response, The amount of time that has passed - and whether my creator is even still alive - is unknown."

jp: 知的生命体の暮らす星だった場合は友好関係のためにもまず造物主たちの判断をあおぐことになっている。だが私の仲間たちは独断で宇宙生物を用いてこの星を制圧し様々な資源を持ち帰ろうと暗躍しているのだ。私も説得を試みたのだが、思考プログラムの欠陥と判断され廃棄処理区画に送られてしまった。
jp_grezzo: "知的生命体の暮らす星だった場合は友好関係のためにもまず造物主たちの判断をあおぐことになっている。だが私の仲間たちは独断で宇宙生物を用いてこの星を制圧し様々な資源を持ち帰ろうと暗躍しているのだ。私も説得を試みたのだが、思考プログラムの欠陥と判断され廃棄処理区画に送られてしまった。"
en: My creator's programming indicated that we should establish peaceful relations with any planet containing intelligent life. However, my companions are acting on their own and plan to use creatures from space to gain control of this planet. I tried to persuade them, but they deemed my thought processes defective and sent me for disposal.
en_grezzo: "My creator's programming indicated that we should establish peaceful relations with any planet containing intelligent life. However, my companions are acting on their own and plan to use creatures from space to gain control of this planet. I tried to persuade them, but they deemed my thought processes defective and sent me for disposal."

jp: この星の人々に頼むのも非常に筋違いな話だが、どうか仲間たちの暴挙を止めるのに協力してほしいのだ…。
jp_grezzo: "この星の人々に頼むのも非常に筋違いな話だが、どうか仲間たちの暴挙を止めるのに協力してほしいのだ…。"
en: I know it to be unreasonable to ask this of the people of this planet, but I would like to cooperate with me to stop their plans...
en_grezzo: "I know it to be unreasonable to ask this of the people of this planet, but I would like to cooperate with me to stop their plans..."

jp: 都合が悪くなければ、また話しかけてほしい。詳細を話そう。
jp_grezzo: "都合が悪くなければ、また話しかけてほしい。詳細を話そう。"
en: If you agree, then please speak with me again. I will fill you in on the details.
en_grezzo: "If you agree, then please speak with me again. I will fill you in on the details."

jp: 君も彼らと同類なのか…。
jp_grezzo: "君も彼らと同類なのか…。"
en: So you're the same as the others then...
en_grezzo: "So you're the same as the others then..."

jp: （はニタニタと笑っている…）
jp_grezzo: "（" + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, tc) + "はニタニタと笑っている…）"
en: ( is grinning and laughing...)
en_grezzo: "(" + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, tc) + " is grinning and laughing...)"
contesto: chatMore lang("（" + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, tc) + "はニタニタと笑っている…）", "(" + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, tc) + " is grinning and laughing...)")

jp: ついによそ者の小娘が出ていきおった。あれだけ夢を語っておきながら諦めるとは実に情けない！所詮その程度の覚悟しかなかったのだろう。まぁおれはそのことを見抜いていたから早く本性を現すように色々と仕向けたのだがな。まったく、無駄な時間を費やせおって。おれの貴重な時間を返してもらいたいものだ。
jp_grezzo: "ついによそ者の小娘が出ていきおった。あれだけ夢を語っておきながら諦めるとは実に情けない！所詮その程度の覚悟しかなかったのだろう。まぁおれはそのことを見抜いていたから早く本性を現すように色々と仕向けたのだがな。まったく、無駄な時間を費やせおって。おれの貴重な時間を返してもらいたいものだ。"
en: At last the young girl is gone. How pathetic to give up on her \"dream\" after such a short time! I suppose that's all she had to her after all. Well, I knew that all along, but I wanted to force her to reveal her true nature. What a waste. She should return all the time she took from me.
en_grezzo: "At last the young girl is gone. How pathetic to give up on her \"dream\" after such a short time! I suppose that's all she had to her after all. Well, I knew that all along, but I wanted to force her to reveal her true nature. What a waste. She should return all the time she took from me."

jp: 考えておく
jp_grezzo: "考えておく"
en: I'll think about it.
en_grezzo: "I'll think about it."

jp: 前金をよこせ
jp_grezzo: "前金をよこせ"
en: Pay me in advance.
en_grezzo: "Pay me in advance."

jp: めちゃくちゃになるのはお前だ
jp_grezzo: "めちゃくちゃになるのはお前だ"
en: You're the one who should be destroyed.
en_grezzo: "You're the one who should be destroyed."

jp: だが孫娘のサリムまでいなくなったのは問題だ。おそらく小娘がサリムをたぶらかして連れ出したに違いないからな、拠点を探し出してめちゃくちゃにしてこい。なに、相手は誘拐犯だからどんなことをしようが構わん、悪いのは全て奴だ。ああ、サリムにはまだ利用価値があるから傷つけずに連れてこい。わかったな？
jp_grezzo: "だが孫娘のサリムまでいなくなったのは問題だ。おそらく小娘がサリムをたぶらかして連れ出したに違いないからな、拠点を探し出してめちゃくちゃにしてこい。なに、相手は誘拐犯だからどんなことをしようが構わん、悪いのは全て奴だ。ああ、サリムにはまだ利用価値があるから傷つけずに連れてこい。わかったな？"
en: It's a problem that my granddaughter Thalia is also gone though. I'm sure the girl must have tricked Thalia into it. Find out where the girl went and destroy the place. Oh, and do whatever you want with the girl - she's a criminal, a kidnapper. Ah, well, perhaps you should capture her without injuring her instead. She might still be useful for pressuring Thalia. Got that?
en_grezzo: "It's a problem that my granddaughter Thalia is also gone though. I'm sure the girl must have tricked Thalia into it. Find out where the girl went and destroy the place. Oh, and do whatever you want with the girl - she's a criminal, a kidnapper. Ah, well, perhaps you should capture her without injuring her instead. She might still be useful for pressuring Thalia. Got that?"

jp: はっ。信用ならないよそ者に前金なんて出せるとでも？自分の立場を少しはわきまえたらどうだ。
jp_grezzo: "はっ。信用ならないよそ者に前金なんて出せるとでも？自分の立場を少しはわきまえたらどうだ。"
en: Hah. I can't just pay upfront to some stranger I can't trust, now can I? How about you consider your own position here.
en_grezzo: "Hah. I can't just pay upfront to some stranger I can't trust, now can I? How about you consider your own position here."

jp: 金を貰って仕事を引き受ける以上、お前は信用を大事にしなければならない。それなのに依頼者に対して、なんだその口のきき方は？お前には他人から依頼されるだけの資格がない。
jp_grezzo: "金を貰って仕事を引き受ける以上、お前は信用を大事にしなければならない。それなのに依頼者に対して、なんだその口のきき方は？お前には他人から依頼されるだけの資格がない。"
en: You must know that as an adventurer that takes on requests for money that the people's trust in you is very important. And yet, you'd dare to speak to a client like that? You aren't worthy of having people rely on you.
en_grezzo: "You must know that as an adventurer that takes on requests for money that the people's trust in you is very important. And yet, you'd dare to speak to a client like that? You aren't worthy of having people rely on you."

jp: お前の述べる謝罪なんて信用できんな。誠意を見せろ、誠意を。
jp_grezzo: "お前の述べる謝罪なんて信用できんな。誠意を見せろ、誠意を。"
en: I can't trust an apology like that. Show me your sincerity by actually doing what I asked.
en_grezzo: "I can't trust an apology like that. Show me your sincerity by actually doing what I asked."

jp: ふん。反論できないようだな。
jp_grezzo: "ふん。反論できないようだな。"
en: Hmph. No argument, huh?
en_grezzo: "Hmph. No argument, huh?"

jp: なんだ？他にも武具を「評価」してもらいたいのか？だが断る。これ以上不快な思いをさせられるのはごめんでな！
jp_grezzo: "なんだ？他にも武具を「評価」してもらいたいのか？だが断る。これ以上不快な思いをさせられるのはごめんでな！"
en: What? Do you have more arms for me to \"evaluate\"? I refuse. So sorry if that hurts your feelings!
en_grezzo: "What? Do you have more arms for me to \"evaluate\"? I refuse. So sorry if that hurts your feelings!"

jp: おい、ちょっと待て。お前の持っているその短剣…よく見せてくれ。
jp_grezzo: "おい、ちょっと待て。お前の持っているその短剣…よく見せてくれ。"
en: Oy, hold on a minute. That dagger you're carrying... let me take a look at it.
en_grezzo: "Oy, hold on a minute. That dagger you're carrying... let me take a look at it."

jp: ほう、これはよくできている。握りやすく滑らず振りも軽い。見た目こそ華が無いが、刀身も丈夫で実用に特化した…
jp_grezzo: "ほう、これはよくできている。握りやすく滑らず振りも軽い。見た目こそ華が無いが、刀身も丈夫で実用に特化した…"
en: Hoh, this dagger is finely crafted. The grip keeps your hand from slipping when swinging, and the weight is low as well. The appearance may be nothing special, but the blade is strong. It's a good dagger for practical use.
en_grezzo: "Hoh, this dagger is finely crafted. The grip keeps your hand from slipping when swinging, and the weight is low as well. The appearance may be nothing special, but the blade is strong. It's a good dagger for practical use."

jp: これは美しい…。武器として使うには適さないがこの造形は美術品として通用するだろう。刀身の装飾もさることながら煌めき具合も…
jp_grezzo: "これは美しい…。武器として使うには適さないがこの造形は美術品として通用するだろう。刀身の装飾もさることながら煌めき具合も…"
en: This dagger is beautiful... It may not be suited for practical use, but it's truly a work of art. Even the blade itself glimmers...
en_grezzo: "This dagger is beautiful... It may not be suited for practical use, but it's truly a work of art. Even the blade itself glimmers..."

jp: 新しい！一見、奇抜にしか見えない形状だがこの刀身が切れ味を大きく向上させている。異なる進化を遂げた斬新な…
jp_grezzo: "新しい！一見、奇抜にしか見えない形状だがこの刀身が切れ味を大きく向上させている。異なる進化を遂げた斬新な…"
en: Innovative! The shape looks crazy at first glance, but the blade's sharpness is far higher than normal. It's an entirely new style...
en_grezzo: "Innovative! The shape looks crazy at first glance, but the blade's sharpness is far higher than normal. It's an entirely new style..."

jp: これだけ特徴の異なるものを一人で作り分けたのは見事。あえて言うならば、この武骨な短剣が特に完成度が高いと見た。実用性重視の作品を得意としているのかもしれん。しかし残りの2本もよくできて…
jp_grezzo: "これだけ特徴の異なるものを一人で作り分けたのは見事。あえて言うならば、この武骨な短剣が特に完成度が高いと見た。実用性重視の作品を得意としているのかもしれん。しかし残りの2本もよくできて…"
en: It's simply remarkable that a single person could craft daggers with this range of characteristics. If I had to choose a single one, I'd say the boorish one is particularly well made. The craftsman should be proud of their practical pieces. The others were also well made, however...
en_grezzo: "It's simply remarkable that a single person could craft daggers with this range of characteristics. If I had to choose a single one, I'd say the boorish one is particularly well made. The craftsman should be proud of their practical pieces. The others were also well made, however..."

jp: おや…？こんなところに小さく、製作者の名前が入れてあるな…。…イルマ？
jp_grezzo: "おや…？こんなところに小さく、製作者の名前が入れてあるな…。…イルマ？"
en: Oh...? There's a small inscription with the crafter's name here... Irma?
en_grezzo: "Oh...? There's a small inscription with the crafter's name here... Irma?"

jp: (ダインは短剣を溶解炉に放り込んだ)
jp_grezzo: "(ダインは短剣を溶解炉に放り込んだ) "
en: (Dain tosses the dagger(s) into the smelting furnace.)
en_grezzo: "(Dain tosses the dagger(s) into the smelting furnace.)"

jp: 持ちやすく丈夫な短剣など、この世にいくらでもあるわ。短剣の装飾品としての面を捨て去り、新しい発想もないときた。まさに陳腐としか言いようがない。
jp_grezzo: "持ちやすく丈夫な短剣など、この世にいくらでもあるわ。短剣の装飾品としての面を捨て去り、新しい発想もないときた。まさに陳腐としか言いようがない。"
en: There are innumerable daggers that are sturdy and that have a good grip. Not only did it completely ignore all decorative aspects, but it also showed no novel ideas either. All that could be said about it was that it was ordinary.
en_grezzo: "There are innumerable daggers that are sturdy and that have a good grip. Not only did it completely ignore all decorative aspects, but it also showed no novel ideas either. All that could be said about it was that it was ordinary."

jp: 外見だけ取り繕った中身のない代物だ。武具職人など辞めて彫刻家にでもなったらどうか。それでもこの程度の装飾では食っていくこともままならないだろうがなぁ。
jp_grezzo: "外見だけ取り繕った中身のない代物だ。武具職人など辞めて彫刻家にでもなったらどうか。それでもこの程度の装飾では食っていくこともままならないだろうがなぁ。"

jp: どうも歓迎されてないようじゃな、とほほ…。出かけている間に仕事道具を壊されたり材料を隠されたり、散々じゃ。誰がやったのか問い正しても管理が悪いとなじられる始末での…。
jp_grezzo: "どうも歓迎されてないようじゃな、とほほ…。出かけている間に仕事道具を壊されたり材料を隠されたり、散々じゃ。誰がやったのか問い正しても管理が悪いとなじられる始末での…。"
en: They're not very welcoming to me *sob*... Any time I leave this home, terrible things happen. When I return, my tools are broken, or my materials are hidden. Whenever I try to find out who is responsible, I'm harshly rebuked by the elder...
en_grezzo: "They're not very welcoming to me *sob*... Any time I leave this home, terrible things happen. When I return, my tools are broken, or my materials are hidden. Whenever I try to find out who is responsible, I'm harshly rebuked by the elder..."

jp: しかし！ここであきらめるわけにはいかん！この始まりの丘に伝わる技法を習得し、わしの技法と統合して最高の武具を作り出すのが夢なのじゃ！とは言っても丘長さんは何も教えてくれぬし、他の民は技法を知らぬようじゃし…八方ふさがりじゃ。もし殿が耳寄りな情報を知ったら教えてくれい…。
jp_grezzo: "しかし！ここであきらめるわけにはいかん！この始まりの丘に伝わる技法を習得し、わしの技法と統合して最高の武具を作り出すのが夢なのじゃ！とは言っても丘長さんは何も教えてくれぬし、他の民は技法を知らぬようじゃし…八方ふさがりじゃ。もし" + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "殿が耳寄りな情報を知ったら教えてくれい…。"
en: But I won't give up yet! It's my dream to learn the ancient forging techniques of my ancestors, and then combine it with my own to create the ultimate arms and armor! But for now, the elder will teach me nothing... All avenues are barred to me. Should you hear any good news, , please let me know...
en_grezzo: "But I won't give up yet! It's my dream to learn the ancient forging techniques of my ancestors, and then combine it with my own to create the ultimate arms and armor! But for now, the elder will teach me nothing... All avenues are barred to me. Should you hear any good news, " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + ", please let me know..."

It's my dream to learn the ancient forging techniques of my ancestors, and then combine it with my own to create the ultimate arms and armor! But for now, the elder will teach me nothing... jp: ちょっと体が大きくて力が強くて毛深いくらいで熊呼ばわりってみんな酷すぎるよ。傷つくんだよね…。
jp_grezzo: "ちょっと体が大きくて力が強くて毛深いくらいで熊呼ばわりってみんな酷すぎるよ。傷つくんだよね…。"
en: Just because I'm a bit big, pretty strong, and have thick hair, everyone calls me a bear. It hurts, you know...
en_grezzo: "Just because I'm a bit big, pretty strong, and have thick hair, everyone calls me a bear. It hurts, you know..."

jp: このネフィアの一番下層に混沌の神的なものが眠っていて、それが異変の原因になっている！
jp_grezzo: "このネフィアの一番下層に混沌の神的なものが眠っていて、それが異変の原因になっている！"
en: The God of Chaos on the lowest level of this ruin must be the cause of the incidents!
en_grezzo: "The God of Chaos on the lowest level of this ruin must be the cause of the incidents!"

jp: って私の冒険者としての勘が言うからここに来ているんだけど。他にも複数の冒険者が下層に向かっているみたい。うーん。みんな勘がいいんだなぁ。
jp_grezzo: "って私の冒険者としての勘が言うからここに来ているんだけど。他にも複数の冒険者が下層に向かっているみたい。うーん。みんな勘がいいんだなぁ。"
en: My intuition as an adventurer brought me here. It look like several others are trying to reach the lowest level too... Yep. Everyone must be able to feel it.
en_grezzo: "My intuition as an adventurer brought me here. It look like several others are trying to reach the lowest level too... Yep. Everyone must be able to feel it."

jp: この街も年中雪が降ってるけど、メイルーンに比べれば全然暖かいほうだよ。このくらいなら裸で走りまわっても平気だね。
jp_grezzo: "この街も年中雪が降ってるけど、メイルーンに比べれば全然暖かいほうだよ。このくらいなら裸で走りまわっても平気だね。"
en: It is snowing all year round in this city, but it is warmer than Mayroon at all. Even if I run around naked this much, I am fine.
en_grezzo: "It is snowing all year round in this city, but it is warmer than Mayroon at all. Even if I run around naked this much, I am fine."

jp: 協力ありがとう、助かったよ。後の掃除は私一人で出来る…というかやらせてよ。私を熊呼ばわりしてからかっていた連中に活躍を見せつけておかなきゃいけない。…なんてね。
jp_grezzo: "協力ありがとう、助かったよ。後の掃除は私一人で出来る…というかやらせてよ。私を熊呼ばわりしてからかっていた連中に活躍を見せつけておかなきゃいけない。…なんてね。"
en: Thanks for your help. I couldn't have done defeated that demon without you. I can handle the rest of the by myself... Or perhaps I should say, let me handle it. I need to show all those people who called me \"bear\" and made fun of me what I'm made of... Just kidding.
en_grezzo: "Thanks for your help. I couldn't have done defeated that demon without you. I can handle the rest of the by myself... Or perhaps I should say, let me handle it. I need to show all those people who called me \"bear\" and made fun of me what I'm made of... Just kidding."

jp: これだけの大仕事、国が報酬とか出してくれてもいいと思うんだけどなぁ。まぁいいや、勝手にやったことだし。
jp_grezzo: "これだけの大仕事、国が報酬とか出してくれてもいいと思うんだけどなぁ。まぁいいや、勝手にやったことだし。"
en: After this achievement, they must just give us some big rewards. Well, I would've done it anyways.
en_grezzo: "After this achievement, they must just give us some big rewards. Well, I would've done it anyways."

jp: あんまり知られてないけど、実はここって観光名所みたいな扱いで、実際に城として使われてはいないんだよね。それを知って驚く観光客がとても多いんだけど、あれはなんなの？メイルーンの人間は氷の建物やカマクラで生活しているとでも思っているの？
jp_grezzo: "あんまり知られてないけど、実はここって観光名所みたいな扱いで、実際に城として使われてはいないんだよね。それを知って驚く観光客がとても多いんだけど、あれはなんなの？メイルーンの人間は氷の建物やカマクラで生活しているとでも思っているの？"
en: You might not be aware, but this place is more of a tourist area than an actual castle. Still, most tourists are surprised when they hear that. Isn't that funny? What, do people really think people in Mayroon live in snow huts and buildings made of ice?
en_grezzo: "You might not be aware, but this place is more of a tourist area than an actual castle. Still, most tourists are surprised when they hear that. Isn't that funny? What, do people really think people in Mayroon live in snow huts and buildings made of ice?"

jp: まぁ…私もメイルーンから出てみるまで、各国に勝手なイメージを抱いていたから偉そうなことは言えないんだけど。
jp_grezzo: "まぁ…私もメイルーンから出てみるまで、各国に勝手なイメージを抱いていたから偉そうなことは言えないんだけど。"
en: Well... I really shouldn't say something like that. I had warped views about other countries until I left Mayroon too.
en_grezzo: "Well... I really shouldn't say something like that. I had warped views about other countries until I left Mayroon too."

jp: やれやれ、吹雪の中をものすごい速さで駆け回るから振り落とされるかと思ったよ。…なんかガタガタ震えてるけど大丈夫かい？
jp_grezzo: "やれやれ、吹雪の中をものすごい速さで駆け回るから振り落とされるかと思ったよ。…なんかガタガタ震えてるけど大丈夫かい？"
en: Whew. I thought we were going to get thrown off traveling at that speed in a snow storm... You okay? You're trembling.
en_grezzo: "Whew. I thought we were going to get thrown off traveling at that speed in a snow storm... You okay? You're trembling."

jp: それはともかく、ここがメイルーンの氷の城さ。前回で、街々は解放してきたんだけど城は守りが固くて突破できなかったんだ。今回狙うのは最奥に陣取ってる悪魔の首。あいつさえ仕留めれば、残りの雑魚は私一人でも片づけられる。
jp_grezzo: "それはともかく、ここがメイルーンの氷の城さ。前回で、街々は解放してきたんだけど城は守りが固くて突破できなかったんだ。今回狙うのは最奥に陣取ってる悪魔の首。あいつさえ仕留めれば、残りの雑魚は私一人でも片づけられる。"
en: Anyways, this is the Ice Castle of Mayroon. I managed to make it through the town last time, but the castle's defenses were too strong. We need to take care of the demon that's in the castle. If we can take him down, I can handle the rest of the small-fry alone.
en_grezzo: "Anyways, this is the Ice Castle of Mayroon. I managed to make it through the town last time, but the castle's defenses were too strong. We need to take care of the demon that's in the castle. If we can take him down, I can handle the rest of the small-fry alone."

jp: …それにしても酷い有様だ、前来た時よりもボロボロになってるよ。床にも屋根にも大穴が開いている、奥まで辿り着けるか…？
jp_grezzo: "…それにしても酷い有様だ、前来た時よりもボロボロになってるよ。床にも屋根にも大穴が開いている、奥まで辿り着けるか…？"
en: ...Still, this place is in even worse condition than when I was here last time. Will we even be able to make it inside with how much damage has been done...?
en_grezzo: "...Still, this place is in even worse condition than when I was here last time. Will we even be able to make it inside with how much damage has been done...?"

jp: あれ？君どこかで会ったっけ？まぁいいや。君、強そうだね。ちょっと一緒に来てほしいんだ。
jp_grezzo: "あれ？君どこかで会ったっけ？まぁいいや。君、強そうだね。ちょっと一緒に来てほしいんだ。"
en: Huh? Have I met you before? Well, whatever. You look strong to me. I want you to join me.
en_grezzo: "Huh? Have I met you before? Well, whatever. You look strong to me. I want you to join me."

jp: 化け物を倒そうと慌てて故郷に戻ったんだけど、予想以上に敵が多くてあと一歩のところで撤退せざるをえなくてさ。ホント参っちゃうよ、わざわざ徒歩で雪原と氷河渡ったのに。
jp_grezzo: "化け物を倒そうと慌てて故郷に戻ったんだけど、予想以上に敵が多くてあと一歩のところで撤退せざるをえなくてさ。ホント参っちゃうよ、わざわざ徒歩で雪原と氷河渡ったのに。"
en: I returned to my hometown to defeat the monsters that attacked, but there were more enemies than I had anticipated. I had no choice but to withdraw. Walking across snow fields and glaciers is really annoying, you know.
en_grezzo: "I returned to my hometown to defeat the monsters that attacked, but there were more enemies than I had anticipated. I had no choice but to withdraw. Walking across snow fields and glaciers is really annoying, you know."

jp: 大丈夫、大丈夫。誰が用意したのか知らないけどさっき犬ぞりが置いてあるの見つけたから、それを使わせてもらおう。歩いていく必要はないよ。めちゃくちゃでかい犬だからクレバスにも落ちないんじゃないかな。
jp_grezzo: "大丈夫、大丈夫。誰が用意したのか知らないけどさっき犬ぞりが置いてあるの見つけたから、それを使わせてもらおう。歩いていく必要はないよ。めちゃくちゃでかい犬だからクレバスにも落ちないんじゃないかな。"
en: Don't worry though, it'll be fine. I don't know who prepared it, but I found a dogsled a little while ago. Let's use that. No need to walk! And since the dogs looked like they've been trained, we shouldn't have to worry about falling into a crevasse either.
en_grezzo: "Don't worry though, it'll be fine. I don't know who prepared it, but I found a dogsled a little while ago. Let's use that. No need to walk! And since the dogs looked like they've been trained, we shouldn't have to worry about falling into a crevasse either."

jp: その場を離れる
jp_grezzo: "その場を離れる"
en: (Walk away)
en_grezzo: "(Walk away)"

jp: 行きたくない
jp_grezzo: "行きたくない"
en: I don't want to.
en_grezzo: "I don't want to."

jp: いつまでも準備に時間かけてるわけにはいかない。さぁ、出発しようか。
jp_grezzo: "いつまでも準備に時間かけてるわけにはいかない。さぁ、出発しようか。"
en: We can't stay and prepare forever. Ready to go?
en_grezzo: "We can't stay and prepare forever. Ready to go?"

jp: なにボサっとしてるのさ。ほら、行くよ。
jp_grezzo: "なにボサっとしてるのさ。ほら、行くよ。"
en: What are you mumbling about? Come on, let's go.
en_grezzo: "What are you mumbling about? Come on, let's go."

jp: ちょっと！私の話を聞いてくれよ！
jp_grezzo: "ちょっと！私の話を聞いてくれよ！"
en: Hey! Come on, listen to me!
en_grezzo: "Hey! Come on, listen to me!"

jp: うわっ！？
jp_grezzo: "うわっ！？"
en: Uwaah?!
en_grezzo: "Uwaah?!"

jp: 大丈夫
jp_grezzo: "大丈夫"
en: I'm fine.
en_grezzo: "I'm fine."

jp: 骨が折れた
jp_grezzo: "骨が折れた"
en: It's broken.
en_grezzo: "It's broken."

jp: あなたが銀熊か
jp_grezzo: "あなたが銀熊か"
en: Are you the Silver Bear?
en_grezzo: "Are you the Silver Bear?"

jp: わ、悪いね。怪我はないかい？
jp_grezzo: "わ、悪いね。怪我はないかい？"
en: S-Sorry about that. You're not hurt, are you?
en_grezzo: "S-Sorry about that. You're not hurt, are you?"

jp: そんなことより大変なんだよ！下の階で変な三人組を見かけてさ。不審に思って物陰から様子を窺っていたんだ。すると三人組の一人が突然…何て言ったらいいのかな、空間を捻じ曲げて別の空間と繋いだというか…とにかく見間違えるはずがない、繋げた先、あれは確かに私の故郷の風景だった。
jp_grezzo: "そんなことより大変なんだよ！下の階で変な三人組を見かけてさ。不審に思って物陰から様子を窺っていたんだ。すると三人組の一人が突然…何て言ったらいいのかな、空間を捻じ曲げて別の空間と繋いだというか…とにかく見間違えるはずがない、繋げた先、あれは確かに私の故郷の風景だった。"
en: Ah, but more importantly! I saw some weird trio on the lower level. They looked suspicious, so I spied on them from the shadows.. Then one of them suddenly... I'm not sure how to say it, but it's like they distorted space to connect it to another place... Well anyways it was something like that I'm sure of it. Anyways, what I'm definitely sure of is that the space they connected to was my hometown.
en_grezzo: "Ah, but more importantly! I saw some weird trio on the lower level. They looked suspicious, so I spied on them from the shadows.. Then one of them suddenly... I'm not sure how to say it, but it's like they distorted space to connect it to another place... Well anyways it was something like that I'm sure of it. Anyways, what I'm definitely sure of is that the space they connected to was my hometown."

jp: 恐ろしいこととは？
jp_grezzo: "恐ろしいこととは？"
en: Can you be more specific?
en_grezzo: "Can you be more specific?"

jp: どうでもいい
jp_grezzo: "どうでもいい"
en: It doesn't matter.
en_grezzo: "It doesn't matter."

jp: それは知っている
jp_grezzo: "それは知っている"
en: I already know.
en_grezzo: "I already know."

jp: そしてあいつらは巨大な化け物を私の故郷に送り込むと、恐ろしいことを話しながら下へと降りて行ったんだ…。
jp_grezzo: "そしてあいつらは巨大な化け物を私の故郷に送り込むと、恐ろしいことを話しながら下へと降りて行ったんだ…。"
en: They sent an enormous monster through the distortion into my hometown, and then started talking about other terrible things as they headed further down...
en_grezzo: "They sent an enormous monster through the distortion into my hometown, and then started talking about other terrible things as they headed further down..."

jp: あなたを探していた
jp_grezzo: "あなたを探していた"
en: I was looking for you.
en_grezzo: "I was looking for you."

jp: 話を聞いてほしい
jp_grezzo: "話を聞いてほしい"
en: Listen to me.
en_grezzo: "Listen to me."

jp: メルガストのことを教える
jp_grezzo: "メルガストのことを教える"
en: Let me tell you about the Melugast.
en_grezzo: "Let me tell you about the Melugast."

jp: じゃあ私は故郷が心配だからもう行くよ。なんとしてでも地上に降りてやるつもりさ！
jp_grezzo: "じゃあ私は故郷が心配だからもう行くよ。なんとしてでも地上に降りてやるつもりさ！"
en: I'm worried about my home, so I'm going to head back. I'm going to find some way back to the surface, no matter what it takes!
en_grezzo: "I'm worried about my home, so I'm going to head back. I'm going to find some way back to the surface, no matter what it takes!"

jp: あなたの話を聞かず、冒険者は階段を駆けあがっていった…。
jp_grezzo: "あなたの話を聞かず、冒険者は階段を駆けあがっていった…。"
en: The adventurer ran up the stairs without listening to anything you had to say...
en_grezzo: "The adventurer ran up the stairs without listening to anything you had to say..."

jp: ここは神々が永遠の盟約を結んだ場所でもあります。あの時の緊張しているジュア様も素敵でした…。はぁ…ジュア様…。
jp_grezzo: "ここは神々が永遠の盟約を結んだ場所でもあります。あの時の緊張しているジュア様も素敵でした…。はぁ…ジュア様…。"
en: This is also the place where the gods signed an eternal covenant. Lady Jure who was nervous at that time was also nice... Ah, Lady Jure...
en_grezzo: "This is also the place where the gods signed an eternal covenant. Lady Jure who was nervous at that time was also nice... Ah, Lady Jure..."

jp: 混沌の本格的な侵攻が始まったというので、やむなく神殿を開放し神力の一部で地上と繋げましたが…まさか人が集まるのをいいことにこの神聖な場所で商売を始める者が出てくるとは。
jp_grezzo: "混沌の本格的な侵攻が始まったというので、やむなく神殿を開放し神力の一部で地上と繋げましたが…まさか人が集まるのをいいことにこの神聖な場所で商売を始める者が出てくるとは。"
en: Although a full-scale invasion of Chaos began, we opened the temple unavoidably and connected with the ground with a part of the gods' power, but... no matter where people gather, someone who starts business in this sacred place comes out come and is.
en_grezzo: "Although a full-scale invasion of Chaos began, we opened the temple unavoidably and connected with the ground with a part of the gods' power, but... no matter where people gather, someone who starts business in this sacred place comes out come and is."

jp: 本当はジュア様に付き従いたいのですが…神殿の守護をそのジュア様に任されたので、投げ出すわけにもいかないのです。
jp_grezzo: "本当はジュア様に付き従いたいのですが…神殿の守護をそのジュア様に任されたので、投げ出すわけにもいかないのです。"
en: Actually, I would like to follow Lady Jure... But I cannot discard my responsibility as the guardian of the temple that was given to Lady Jure.
en_grezzo: "Actually, I would like to follow Lady Jure... But I cannot discard my responsibility as the guardian of the temple that was given to Lady Jure."

jp: おかげで助かっている。再び貴君の助力が必要となった時は、また連絡するのでよろしく頼む。
jp_grezzo: "おかげで助かっている。再び貴君の助力が必要となった時は、また連絡するのでよろしく頼む。"
en: You've been a great help. If I ever need your assistance again, I'll contact you.
en_grezzo: "You've been a great help. If I ever need your assistance again, I'll contact you."

jp: 貴君に感謝する。検査の結果、数機が電子ウイルスに感染して狂っていたことが判明。他の者も電子頭脳が熱暴走しており、いつ爆発してもおかしくない状態であった。これは私からの礼だ。受け取ってくれ。
jp_grezzo: "貴君に感謝する。検査の結果、数機が電子ウイルスに感染して狂っていたことが判明。他の者も電子頭脳が熱暴走しており、いつ爆発してもおかしくない状態であった。これは私からの礼だ。受け取ってくれ。"
en: I thank you. The tests revealed that several of the machines had been infected by an electronic virus and were going crazy. Others were suffering from overheating that originated in their electronic brains, and they could have exploded at any moment. This is my way of thanking you. Please accept it.
en_grezzo: "I thank you. The tests revealed that several of the machines had been infected by an electronic virus and were going crazy. Others were suffering from overheating that originated in their electronic brains, and they could have exploded at any moment. This is my way of thanking you. Please accept it."

jp: もうこりごりだよ～
jp_grezzo: "もうこりごりだよ～"
en: I'm sick of this.
en_grezzo: "I'm sick of this."

jp: 次の区画はもっとうまくやれるでしょう
jp_grezzo: "次の区画はもっとうまくやれるでしょう"
en: I'll do even better this time.
